page.overview:
Who is Breadward?

Breadward is a fake pixl mentioned by Mimi in Super Paper Mario.

Not much is known about Breadward, but he is made out of "oats and lard".

In Merlee's Basement Mimi disguises as Merlee; she mentions Breadward to bribe Mario and his party within Merlee's Mansion. In this part of the game, the player is not supposed to accept these offers.
